description: Set a breakpoint and report honestly whether Chrome could bind it. Accepts either a loaded script URL (a substring is resolved to the exact script) or an original pre-bundling file path, which is translated through the source map. Set auto_resume:true when the action is being driven by an automation tool, so the page does not stay frozen and time that action out.

auto_resume.description: Default true: capture scope/console/network on hit, then resume, so the page is never left frozen and the action that tripped it completes. Pass false to hold the pause for stepping; released after maxPauseMs regardless.

column.description: 1-based column, when several statements share a line.

condition.description: JavaScript condition — pause only when it is truthy, e.g. 'id === 42'.

line.description: 1-based line number, as shown by source_get_script / source_get_file.

url.description: Script URL, URL substring, or original source path.

name: debugger_set_breakpoint
